eventDetail.scope: This symposium reports on activities which aim at realizing the vision of "Computing Everywhere," i.e. the IoT (Internet of Things), or ubiquitous computing environment based on "open" approach including "open architecture", "open API" and "open data." The symposium will introduce IoT-Aggregator and IoT-Engine, fundamental technologies that realize the Open IoT, as well as cutting-edge IoT applications including ones which utilize open data to solve real-world problems such as disaster relief, tourism, transportation, and environmental problems. The latest research, products and services on ubiquitous computing, the IoT and embedded systems are presented. In the field of embedded computing, open platform for the IoT, including real-time OS "micro T-Kernel", based on IEEE standard, as well as development environments, middleware, applications such as mobile devices and IoT-enabled consumer electronics, all of which forms the TRON ecosystem, are presented.
